hypothesis: The same physical parameter box and plant expressed in different units give the same PLSR verdicts: box membership is preserved by a monotone conversion and the sign of the decrease form is congruence-invariant.
input_data: Samples: k = 8 and 12 (bounds), nextafter(8, 0) and nextafter(12, inf) (just outside), 8 interior k (PCG64 seed 1052), states from a normal draw; bounds and neighbours converted both as k * c and as k / (1 / c) against a box converted as bound * c
Light-damping twin: k = 10, c = 1e-8, SI margin 5e-9
Conversion scan: 2000 bounds 10^U(-3, 6) (seed 1051) with factors 1e-3 and 1e-6
mathematical_model: Mass-spring-damper m = 2 kg, c = 3 N s/m, stiffness k in [8, 12] N/m: A(k) = A0 + k A1, common P = [[6, 0.75], [0.75, 1]] (exactly negative definite decrease at both vertices, hence on the box). A unit change is x' = T x, t' = t/tau, k' = c k: A' = tau T A T^-1, P' = T^-1 P T^-1. Inertia is invariant; eigenvalues, max|A| and max|P| (hence margin and resolution) are not.
numerical_result: Interior/bound samples: 0 code mismatches across 5 unit systems; vertex check passed in 5/5. Just-outside MSD samples admitted: 0; MSD bound samples refused when converted as k/(1/c): 0; just-outside samples admitted when converted as k/(1/c): 1 (['um, ms, N/um|k just below 8']). Interior margin ratio spread 7.6e+06x. Light damping codes {'m, s, N/m': 'CERTIFIED_WITH_MARGIN', 'mm, s, N/mm': 'CERTIFIED_WITH_MARGIN', 'm, ms, N/m': 'NUMERICAL_INCONCLUSIVE', 'um, ms, N/um': 'NUMERICAL_INCONCLUSIVE', '2^-10 m, 2^-7 s, 2^10 N/m': 'CERTIFIED_WITH_MARGIN'} (ratios {'m, s, N/m': 45000.0, 'mm, s, N/mm': 45000.0, 'm, ms, N/m': 0.00563, 'um, ms, N/um': 0.00563, '2^-10 m, 2^-7 s, 2^10 N/m': 2.68}; exact classes {'m, s, N/m': 'negative_definite', 'mm, s, N/mm': 'negative_definite', 'm, ms, N/m': 'negative_definite', 'um, ms, N/um': 'negative_definite', '2^-10 m, 2^-7 s, 2^10 N/m': 'negative_definite'}). Isolated box witnesses: {'collision 0.001|SI': 'OUTSIDE_PARAMETER_BOX', 'collision 0.001|x1e-3': 'CERTIFIED_WITH_MARGIN', 'formula 0.001|SI': 'CERTIFIED_WITH_MARGIN', 'formula 0.001|x1e-3': 'OUTSIDE_PARAMETER_BOX'}. Conversion scan: {'0.001': 32, '1e-06': 78} neighbour collisions and {'0.001': 282, '1e-06': 612} formula disagreements in 2000 draws. Conclusion: well-inside samples agree in every unit system; the declared MSD bounds keep their box decision under both conversion formulas and their neighbours under multiplication, but mixing the two formulas admits a just-outside neighbour; isolated bounds collide or depend on the conversion formula; near-threshold verdicts depend on the units because the resolution is not congruence-invariant.
